Allternit PDF Editor app icon (vendored from upstream PdfCraft; the files keep the upstream
`pdfcraft` names: pdfcraft.svg, pdfcraft-small.svg, pdfcraft-1024.png, pdfcraft.icns,
pdfcraft.ico, hicolor/).

Original artwork made for the upstream project by the project owner, drawn in ArtCraft and
vectorised for PdfCraft (no third-party material). Licensed like the rest of the upstream
project, under either of

  * Apache License, Version 2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)
  * MIT license (https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

at your option.

Regenerate the derived files with packaging/icons.sh.
